title: Interactive Race & Ethnicity Map of Sarasota County
text:
Explore the racial and ethnic makeup across Sarasota County, Florida, based on 2020 Decennial Census tract data. Use the layer selector in the top-right to switch demographic views, and hover over any census tract to inspect its specific counts and percentages.







Key Observations

Newtown (Census Tract 3): Located in North Sarasota, this historically Black community has a 74.5% Black population—in stark contrast to the countywide median of just 1.2%.
Hispanic Hubs: Visible along central and southern corridors of the county, where Hispanic residents make up 30–38% of several tracts.
Predominantly White Tracts: Coastal and suburban tracts remain over 85–90% non-Hispanic White.
